price.title: Pricing & Plans
price.subtitle: Simple, transparent pricing for your wholesale business. Start free, upgrade as you grow.
price.billing_faq_a1: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated to your billing cycle.
price.billing_faq_a2: Your subscription remains active until the end of your current billing period. After that, you'll be moved to the Free plan.
price.billing_faq_q3: How do I view or download invoices?
price.billing_faq_a3: You can view and download all invoices in the Creem customer portal.
price.billing_faq_q4: How do I request a refund?
price.billing_faq_a4: Since we use Creem as our payment processor, refund requests are handled manually. Please email us at wholesalify@hotmail.com with your subscription ID and we'll get back to you within 1-3 business days.
price.billing_faq_a5: You can cancel your subscription anytime for any reason. Your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing period. After that, you'll be moved to the Free plan and can continue using basic features.
